goal: In the sample project, make the retry backoff cap configurable instead of hard-coded, keeping the current value as the default, and cover the new behaviour with a unit test.

dod: the new unit test fails against the pre-change code
the full unit suite of the sample project is green

milestones.title: Configurable backoff cap with a passing unit test

rationale: The floor of the gauntlet: the smallest complete mission there is. If this one needs an operator command, nothing above it can be trusted. No new surface, no new file, one behaviour, one test — it probes the loop itself rather than any capability, and it is the only order that does.
title: Change one function's behaviour and prove it with a unit test
